reviews.review: It seems every time the devs put out a "patch" to fix reported problems, they add at least 4 more bugs. Ever since this challenge mode update, which no one asked for by the way, the game has lost all appeal to me. Not to mention the devs are still pretending the challenge mode outfit weren't made with AI when it is blatantly obvious. Congrats on ruining your own game again and again! You have done it again, constantly lowering the bar for us all.
